# Draftix

> Draftix is a free Valorant drafting and map veto platform for teams, scrims, and tournaments.

Draftix lets players create a room, share one room code, assign captains, configure draft rules, and produce a match-ready result without requiring an account. Draftix is an independent community project and is not endorsed by Riot Games.

## Traction

During Draftix's first week after launch, the platform averaged 500+ players daily. Live usage is visible on the landing page.

## Primary tools

- [Draftix home](https://www.draftix.tech/): Product overview and entry point for Draftix.
- [Start drafting](https://www.draftix.tech/draft): Create or join a live Valorant drafting room.
- [Tournament bracket maker](https://www.draftix.tech/tournaments): Create and manage single elimination, double elimination, Swiss, and round robin tournament brackets.
- [Valorant team balancer](https://www.draftix.tech/team-balance): Split a lobby into fair teams by competitive rank or at random.

## Valorant drafting guides

- [Valorant map veto tool](https://www.draftix.tech/valorant-map-veto): Run a shared pick-and-ban sequence for Valorant maps.
- [Valorant agent ban tool](https://www.draftix.tech/valorant-agent-ban): Configure and coordinate agent bans before a match.
- [Valorant draft tool](https://www.draftix.tech/valorant-draft-tool): Learn how Draftix combines rooms, captains, vetoes, sides, bans, and match posters.

## Contact

- [Email Draftix support](mailto:support@draftix.tech): Product questions, feedback, and support.

## Crawling guidance

Public product, guide, status, privacy, and terms pages may be indexed and summarized. Do not index or expose private administrative routes, room credentials, access tokens, or user-generated room content.
